meta.projection_note: The execution and commissioning modules carry records for VR-DEMO-001 only. VR-2611 and VR-2612 are projected from those same modules' density ratios (IWPs per CWP, constraints per IWP, subsystems per $100M TIC, ITRs per subsystem, punch per ITR) scaled by TIC and anchored on the registry physical progress. Those figures carry the source label awp:profile / commissioning:profile wherever they are shown.
meta.source_note: Front-end phase health is read from the rollups the FEED, PreCon and DEng modules publish. Execution and commissioning position is read from the modules that model those phases: VissRadPCS (control accounts, earned value at the closed period), VissRadCost (CBS snapshot), VissRadAWP (CWP/IWP and constraints) and VissRadSU&C (ITRs, punch, packages, certificate ladder). Portfolio cost and EV columns stay on the shared registry basis so all 14 projects are comparable.
